_comment: BEACON — recorded imagery tiles for the offline `fixture:<id>` vision path (S2·Lane V). Real bytes, really fetched from NASA GIBS on the recorded_at date below via WMS 1.1.1 GetMap; nothing here is synthetic or drawn. Before this file the `fixture:` scheme named images that did not exist on disk. Satellite terrain only — no reporter PII is present in any tile (Art. XIV); `piiScreened` remains a structural gate re-checked at the compliance gateway, never an assertion made by this file. MockVision reads NO pixels (see mock-vision.ts) — only the cloud/local rungs open these bytes.
license: NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview imagery — NASA open data, free to use, attribution requested (see NOTICE)

tiles.product: MODIS Terra corrected reflectance, bands 7-2-1 (SWIR/NIR/Red) — the wildfire false-colour composite in which burn scars read dark red-brown against green vegetation
VIIRS NOAA-20 corrected reflectance, bands M11-I2-I1 — the second-sensor fire false colour over the SAME bbox and day, so a degraded-sensor scenario can be rehearsed rather than assumed

MODIS Terra true colour over the Indus basin during the 2022 Sindh floods — standing water is visible in true colour, which is why the flood task defaults to this product and not to the 7-2-1 fire composite
